title: Westeros events
actionHint: Open events for Watch contributions, ties and card effects.
automatic: The server is resolving effects. No action is required from you yet.
secretCard: The wildling card is still hidden
secretHint: Revealed after contributions and selection of the highest or lowest contributor.
bidHint: A confirmed contribution cannot be changed. Power is spent only once everyone commits.
bidInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to {p0}.
excluded: House {p0} is exempt from this repeat attack: no contribution, reward or penalty.
highestTie: Choose the highest contributor among the tied houses.
lowestTie: Choose the lowest contributor among the tied houses.
choiceHint: This action cannot be undone. Check the target before confirming.
lose-influence: Lose positions on your highest track
partialPenalty: Both penalties are legal even if you cannot fulfill them completely.
noHistory: Westeros cards are revealed starting in round two.
softTimer: The soft timer does not make decisions for you.
hardTimer: Hard timer: the server performs a legal action when time expires.
choices.discard-card: Choose a house card to discard
choices.upgrade-footman: Upgrade a footman to a knight
choices.downgrade-knight: Replace a knight with a footman
choices.destroy-knight: Destroy a knight: no footman is available
decisions.clash-of-kings: Clash of Kings: bid for influence
cards.silence-at-the-wall.name: Silence at the Wall
cards.preemptive-raid.name: Preemptive Raid
cards.preemptive-raid.won: A new attack of strength 6. The highest contributor is exempt from it and its rewards and penalties.
cards.preemptive-raid.lost: The lowest contributor chooses two unit losses anywhere or a two-place drop on their highest track. The Throne chooses between tied tracks. Everyone else is unaffected.
cards.crow-killers.name: Crow Killers
cards.crow-killers.won: The highest contributor may replace up to two footmen with available knights.
cards.crow-killers.lost: The lowest contributor replaces all knights with footmen; everyone else replaces two. Knights without an available replacement are destroyed.
cards.rattleshirts-raiders.name: Rattleshirt’s Raiders
cards.rattleshirts-raiders.won: The highest contributor moves up one supply space.
cards.rattleshirts-raiders.lost: The lowest contributor drops two supply spaces; everyone else drops one, no lower than zero. Excess armies must disband.
cards.massing-on-the-milkwater.name: Massing on the Milkwater
cards.massing-on-the-milkwater.won: The highest contributor returns their entire house card discard pile to their hand.
cards.massing-on-the-milkwater.lost: If holding more than one card, the lowest contributor discards all highest-strength cards; everyone else discards one chosen card.
cards.a-king-beyond-the-wall.name: A King Beyond the Wall
cards.a-king-beyond-the-wall.won: The highest contributor moves to first place on an influence track of their choice.
cards.a-king-beyond-the-wall.lost: The lowest contributor moves to the bottom of all tracks. Everyone else chooses Fiefdoms or King’s Court and moves to the bottom of that track.
cards.mammoth-riders.name: Mammoth Riders
cards.mammoth-riders.won: The highest contributor may retrieve one discarded house card.
cards.mammoth-riders.lost: The lowest contributor destroys three units anywhere; everyone else destroys two.
cards.the-horde-descends.name: The Horde Descends
cards.the-horde-descends.won: The highest contributor may muster normally in one controlled castle or stronghold.
cards.the-horde-descends.lost: The lowest contributor destroys two units in one castle or stronghold; if unable, two anywhere. Everyone else destroys one.
cards.skinchanger-scout.name: Skinchanger Scout
cards.skinchanger-scout.won: The highest contributor receives back the power they contributed to this attack.
cards.skinchanger-scout.lost: The lowest contributor loses all available power; everyone else loses two tokens or as many as they have.
cards.supply.name: Supply
cards.supply.description: Recalculate supply from controlled lands and reconcile armies with its limits.
cards.mustering.name: Mustering
cards.mustering.description: Recruit in castles and strongholds subject to supply and available pieces.
cards.a-throne-of-blades.name: A Throne of Blades
cards.a-throne-of-blades.description: The Throne holder chooses Supply, Mustering or no effect.
cards.last-days-of-summer.name: Last Days of Summer
cards.last-days-of-summer.description: No additional event. The wildling icon increases threat.
cards.winter-is-coming.name: Winter Is Coming
cards.winter-is-coming.description: Reshuffle this deck with its discard pile and reveal another card.
cards.game-of-thrones.name: Game of Thrones
cards.game-of-thrones.description: Gain power for crowns in controlled lands and eligible ports.
cards.clash-of-kings.name: Clash of Kings
cards.clash-of-kings.description: Bid for the Iron Throne, Fiefdoms and King’s Court.
cards.dark-wings-dark-words.name: Dark Wings, Dark Words
cards.dark-wings-dark-words.description: The Raven holder chooses influence bidding, gaining power or no effect.
cards.put-to-the-sword.name: Put to the Sword
cards.put-to-the-sword.description: The Blade holder chooses no Defense, no March +1 or no effect.
cards.storm-of-swords.name: Storm of Swords
cards.storm-of-swords.description: No Defense orders may be assigned this round.
cards.rains-of-autumn.name: Rains of Autumn
cards.rains-of-autumn.description: No special March +1 order may be assigned this round.
cards.sea-of-storms.name: Sea of Storms
cards.sea-of-storms.description: No Raid orders may be assigned this round.
cards.web-of-lies.name: Web of Lies
cards.web-of-lies.description: No Support orders may be assigned this round.
cards.feast-for-crows.name: Feast for Crows
cards.feast-for-crows.description: No Consolidate Power orders may be assigned this round.
cards.wildlings-attack.name: Wildlings Attack
cards.wildlings-attack.description: The Watch contributes against the current threat, even if it is zero.
